crossRefs.note: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.
When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.
She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.
There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number.
“Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.

parallels.note: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will…
He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.
translations.bsb: Jesus replied, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them? As long as He is with them, they cannot fast.
translations.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
translations.asv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the sons of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.
